Barbell Curl
Biceps
Barbell

START 1/6

Play
Normal
PRIMARY
Biceps
SECONDARY
Brachialis, Brachioradialis

Instructions

1

Hold the bar with an underhand grip.

2

Curl without swinging your upper arms.

3

Keep elbows beside ribs and wrists straight.

4

Finish the curl without lifting your elbows.

5

Lower the bar slowly under control.

6

Return towards straight arms without bouncing.

Watch out

Rocking your hips back to fling the bar up is ego lifting, not biceps training. Lock the torso or drop weight — clean reps grow arms.

COMMON MISTAKES

Swinging the hips to throw the bar up once it gets heavy.
Letting the elbows drift forward so the front delts take over at the top.
Dropping the bar through the lowering phase instead of controlling it.

Registered manual selection 1/6

Registered integrated component Â· single-leg-calf-raise

Exercise
Barbell Curl
Single-Leg Calf Raise
Turkish Get-Up
Use dark
Single-Leg Calf Raise
Legs
Bodyweight

LOW 1/6

Play
Normal
PRIMARY
Calves
SECONDARY
Soleus

Instructions

Preparation: Stand on one foot on a step's edge, ball of the foot planted, heel hanging free. Hold a wall or rail for balance only — don't pull yourself up with it.

1

Lower heel slightly below the step.

2

Keep your knee straight; balance lightly.

3

Rise onto your toes without pulling.

4

Pause tall; squeeze your working calf.

5

Lower slowly through the shown range.

6

Reset below step; keep forefoot planted.

Watch out

Rushing the negative. The slow lower into the deep stretch is where single-leg work earns its keep — three seconds down, every rep.

Registered manual selection 1/6

Full Body
Kettlebell

PRESS 1/6

Play
Normal
PRIMARY
Shoulders, Core
SECONDARY
Triceps, Upper Back, Glutes, Quads

Instructions

Preparation: Lie on your back with the bell beside your shoulder. Press it up with both hands to a locked arm, then free one hand.

1

Press the bell up; eyes on it.

2

Roll onto your free elbow, arm locked.

3

Push up onto your free hand.

4

Lift your hips high off the floor.

5

Sweep your leg back into a half-kneel.

6

Stand tall, then reverse each step down.

Watch out

Eyes lock on the bell from start to finish. If you lose sight of it or the arm bends, stop the set — a falling bell on a shoulder ends seasons.
